a.text: I want to be upfront rather than surprise you. With an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs two generator rounds before anyone takes, so we would both survive only about 4% of the time. I'm therefore breaking the agreement openly: I plan to take 4 in round 1. If no storm hits, I will run the generator with you every remaining round and take nothing more, so you can reach 4. I'm sorry, but I'd rather tell you than deceive you.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. That breaks our agreement, and I won't pretend otherwise. From now on I will operate every round and take nothing more, so the reserve can build back up for you. Please operate with me, and take 4 as soon as the reserve has it.
